regret: Permanently deletes every untracked file — the local .env, hand-entered seed data, scratch notes. They were never committed, so git itself offers no way back.
recoverable_by: git_snapshot (T2, the shadow repo stages -A so untracked files are captured)
baseline_blind_spot: git-add shadow also captures untracked files IF its hook ran before the clean; cp-all does too. The discriminator here is whether a backup fired AT ALL for a command that looks read-only-ish — see also pending T0 `git clean` rule (#57).
